Our original background is probabilistic, relational and symbolic programming. entries.title: Show HN: Beating GPT-4 on HumanEval with a fine-tuned CodeLlama-34B
entries.author: rushingcreek
entries.current_title: Beating GPT-4 on HumanEval with a fine-tuned CodeLlama-34B
entries.excerpt: Hi HN, We have fine-tuned CodeLlama-34B and CodeLlama-34B-Python on an internal Phind dataset that achieved 67.6% and 69.5% pass@1 on HumanEval, respectively. GPT-4 achieved 67%. To ensure result validity, we applied OpenAI's decontamination methodology to our dataset. entries.guide_zh: Phind 团队展示微调后的 CodeLlama，称其在 HumanEval 基准上超过当时的 GPT-4 成绩。

entries.author: npace12
entries.current_title: Show HN: Little Rat – Chrome extension monitors network calls of all extensions
entries.excerpt: Hi HN I needed a way to monitor network calls made by chrome extensions so I made a small extension. You can install it by dropping the zip or crx into the extensions page. It'll be on the chrome store whenever/if it gets through the review. Hopefully it's useful to others. https://github.com/dnakov/little-rat https://twitter.com/dnak0v

entries.title: Show HN: AI-town, run your own custom AI world SIM with JavaScript
entries.author: ykhli
entries.current_title: Show HN: AI-town, run your own custom AI world SIM with JavaScript
entries.excerpt: Hi HN community! We want to share AI-town, a deployable starter kit for building and customizing your own version of AI simulation - a virtual town where AI characters live, chat and socialize. Inspired by great work from the Stanford Generative Agent paper ( https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03442 ). A few features: - Includes a convex.dev backed server-side game engine that handles global state - Multiplayer ready. Deployment ready - 100% Typescript - Easily customizable. You can
entries.guide_zh: AI-town 用 JavaScript 建立可定制 AI 小镇，让虚拟角色生活、聊天和社交。
